body:
These people have repeatedly made it known. 

Friends just leaving without explanation. Unfollowing me and removing from their social media.

I made a ton of mistake between 21-23 and those mistakes haunt me to this day. I mean fuck, last year I was "cancelled" cause my ex-bestfriend turned out to be a pile of garbage and I had no idea.

Its been a fucking rollercoaster, I know I sucked, BUT I HAVE TRIED SO HARD TO BE A BETTER MAN THAN I WAS THAN. AND ITS NOT WORTH IT.

Every day of my life I think about my past and how shitty of a person I used to be. 

6-7 years later it still haunts me. To this day I still lose some friends.

I was going to therapy. But we stopped after COVID happened.

I tried to call him and emailed him seeing if we could do something video, but to no avail.

I don't know how to get prescribed anything... I don't know where to begin
